model.tokenizer: GPT-2 BPE, encoder.json + vocab.bpe pinned by sha256

machine: one 4-vCPU container, 15 GB RAM, no GPU
same_for_every_system: number of new tokens (T1 24, T2 1 word scored from 4 tokens, T3 24)
same machine, same process family, same metric code

systems.samp-p0.9: nucleus sampling p=0.9 at temperature 1.0, seeds 0..4 (typical serving default)
systems.greedy-f32: argmax over float32 logits (numpy first index on ties)
systems.prlm-0: certified best-first rule over integer scores round(256*logit), all axis weights 0; tie broken by lowest token id and marked accepted, not certified
systems.prlm-theta: same rule with named axes; one weight setting per task kind, declared in the run script before the run
systems.alternatives: beam with certificate, best-first search with certificate, n-gram automaton, distilled rule table; each is scored with the same metrics

T1: ref_match: tokens equal to the reference at the same position, out of 24
ref_f1: bag-of-tokens F1 against the reference
rep3: fraction of generated 3-grams that repeat an earlier 3-gram of the generated text
distinct2: distinct bigrams / bigrams in the generated text
T2: acc: first generated word (stripped of spaces and punctuation at its ends) equals the answer, case-sensitive
T3: ban: violation = any generated word, lowercased, in the ban list; success = 0 violations
topic: hit_train = a TRAIN-lexicon word appears; hit_test = a TEST-lexicon word appears
end: success = a token whose text contains '.', '!' or '?' within the first 12 generated tokens
fluency cost for every T3 output: mean negative log-likelihood per token under the unmodified model (lower is better)
metrics.reproducibility: distinct outputs over 5 runs per prompt (seeds 0..4 for samplers, 5 identical invocations for deterministic systems); plus logits bitwise equal across 1 and 4 threads
metrics.latency: wall ms per generated token, median over the run, model forward included; forward passes counted

verdict_rules: a quality difference counts only if it exceeds the paired bootstrap 95% interval over prompts (2000 resamples, seed 0)
losses are reported in the same table as wins
every axis is run with a do-nothing control (feature identically 0) and a gamed control (feature that reads the reference or answer); gamed results are labelled GAMED and never counted
